dn24:1.3.15: paccācikkhati → katthaci potthake paccakkhāsīti pāṭho dissati.
dn24:1.5.18: aparaddhanti → sī. ma. yu. itisaddo na dissati.
dn24:1.20.5: lomahaṭṭhajāto → katthaci potthake lomahaṃsajātoti pāṭho dissati.
